records.part: Retrofit of ten (10) 12kV, 1200Amp magnetic-actuator type power circuit breakers for Maybell Substation, including installation, training and commissioning
records.reason: Staff has determined that the only viable and cost-effective option for replacing the circuit breakers in Maybell Substation is to use retrofitted breakers manufactured by ABB Inc., which is the successor company to the original manufacturer.
